basics.name: Salah Eddine Ibn El Hachimy
basics.label: Entrepreneur | Finance Professional | Workshop Facilitator
basics.summary:
I'm a Moroccan entrepreneur and finance professional currently pursuing a Master's in Finance, Control & Audit (pending defense, 2026). I co-founded TawjihYou, an AI-powered platform for student orientation and mentoring, and Dar l'Khir, an e-commerce venture.

My work blends analytical rigor with entrepreneurial spirit—specializing in financial modeling, internal control, and AI implementation for social impact. I'm passionate about experiential learning, having facilitated workshops at Microsoft Tech Days, university competitions, and regional entrepreneurship forums.

As a workshop facilitator and educator, I've trained over 200 students through hands-on programs in Design Thinking, AI tools, and startup methodology. I believe in empowering youth through accessible education and innovative technology.

work.name: TawjihYou
work.summary: Co-founded an AI-powered platform that provides orientation and mentoring services to Moroccan students and youth. The platform combines educational technology with personalized guidance to support career development and academic success.
highlights: Launched AI mentoring platform serving 50+ students
Developed curriculum for digital literacy and career guidance
Facilitated 200+ workshop participants across multiple programs
Built partnerships with educational institutions and youth organizations

work.name: Dar l'Khir
work.summary: Co-founded an e-commerce venture focused on innovative commerce solutions in Morocco. The business combines modern digital strategies with traditional commerce practices to create accessible retail experiences.
highlights: Established e-commerce operations with focus on Moroccan market
Developed supply chain and logistics frameworks
Implemented digital marketing and customer acquisition strategies

work.name: Freelance Educator & Workshop Facilitator
work.summary: Personal training and mentoring services for students and organizations. Specializing in experiential learning, Design Thinking workshops, and AI implementation for education.
highlights: Delivered Design Thinking workshops at Cité de l'Innovation
Facilitated university startup competitions (2nd Place winner)
Conducted AI implementation learning at Microsoft Tech Day
Trained 50+ students in digital literacy and entrepreneurship
